delegationTransportation.faq.multipleVeh: Yes. Delegation Transportation supports multiple vehicles within one confirmed request.
delegationTransportation.faq.mixedClasse: Yes. Different vehicle classes can be combined when the passenger structure and confirmed programme require different vehicle roles.
delegationTransportation.faq.coordinator: Yes. The service supports dedicated coordination so vehicles, groups, locations and timing remain part of one transport plan.
delegationTransportation.faq.groupMoveme: Yes. Include the different pickup points, destinations and group structure in the request. The final schedule is reviewed and confirmed as one organisation.
delegationTransportation.faq.ndaAnswer: You can state an NDA or another formal confidentiality condition in the request. The condition applies only after both parties agree it in writing before the confirmed engagement.
delegationTransportation.faq.confirmatio: No. The team reviews availability, vehicles, the schedule and request details before manually confirming the organisation.
delegationTransportation.faq.securityAns: No. Delegation Transportation covers transport and vehicle coordination. Physical security, protection and escort services are not part of this service.
